edits.new:
Then the route path and the deployment topology detail are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0624; ASM-0923; ASM-0928)

  Scenario: AC10 The release writes only its own schema and reads other services only through contracts (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the release and its reads and writes of other services
    When its writes and reads are inspected
    Then it writes only schema rwb_agent and holds no write right on any other schema
    Then it reads other services only through their contracts, one hop and within the 2 s budget each

  Scenario: AC11 A redelivered consumed event starts no second run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the consumer of rwb.case.events.v1 and a synthetic rwb.case.CaseCreated.v1 event
    When the same event is delivered a second time
    Then no second run is started for the case and the event
    Then the redelivery is recorded as processed and is not reprocessed

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is counted and its answer is not used (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call to the P3 case read or the P4 authorise call
    When the call fails or does not answer within 2 s
    Then the failure is counted on the dashboard as a tool read failure
    Then no answer from the failed call is used by the run
